Checkpoint
Six questions. You know the plan when you can answer them.
Pick an answer. The right one lights up green, with the reason. A wrong answer is fine — that is how we learn. Nothing is recorded anywhere but on your own device.
Question 1 of 6
Your friend's contract earns something today. What do you get for each level?
2% of what the contract earns that day
2% of the purchase price
42% of what it earns
Two percent of what the contract earns that day. Never a share of the purchase price.
Question 2 of 6
Everest is the top rank. On how many levels is it paid?
Three levels per rank: Fuji 3, Kilimanjaro 6 … Everest 21.
Question 3 of 6
What is the daily cap at Fuji, the first rank?
There is no cap
The caps go from 1,000 USDT at Fuji to 7,000 USDT at Everest. They apply to the base matrix; the differential has no cap.
Question 4 of 6
At Fuji, how much of your volume can one single line count for?
Half, at most
A fifth
All of it — one line is enough
Half at Fuji and Kilimanjaro, a third at Matterhorn and Denali, a quarter at Rainier, a fifth at K-2 and Everest. Build wide.
Question 5 of 6
What is the most a module can give back?
2× its price, price included (2.2× for a Believer)
Unlimited, as long as it runs
Only the price back
A module ends at two times its price, price included. A Believer, with Auto-Rebuy on for the whole life, ends at 2.2×.
Question 6 of 6
Which sentence goes with every conversation?
The engine never has a zero day
Most members earn no commission at all; results and rewards are not guaranteed
A module pays every day, no matter what
The disclosure line. Every figure is an illustration at the engine's average daily result.

Explain the Momentum Plan to a friend in three sentences: what you buy, how introducing people pays, and what is never promised. Write it here, then compare with the model answer. Your words stay on your device.
Save my words
Show the model answer
A model answer
1. You buy a module. It is a software purchase, and at the engine's average daily result it can give back up to two times its price, price included.
2. When you introduce people, you get 2% of what their contracts earn each day, on up to 21 levels, depending on your rank. Leaders add the breakage differential.
3. Nothing is promised: some days are zero, the price cannot be refunded, and most members earn no commission at all.

Every figure on this site and in every document is a hypothetical illustration at the engine's average daily result. Individual days vary and can be zero; results and rewards are not guaranteed.
